probes.question: True or false: al-Qarawiyyin was founded as a mosque.

image.alt: The ornate carved-wood and stucco fountain pavilion in the courtyard of the al-Qarawiyyin mosque in Fez, with the minaret lit against the night sky

panels.text: Fez, Morocco, 9th century. In the story of the founding, Fatima al-Fihri and her sister Mariam, both well educated, inherit a large amount of money from their father.
Fatima vows to spend her entire inheritance to build a mosque suitable for her community.
The al-Qarawiyyin mosque is founded in 857-859. It subsequently becomes one of the leading spiritual and educational centers of the Islamic Golden Age.
The twist: UNESCO and Guinness World Records have cited al-Qarawiyyin as the oldest university or oldest continually operating higher learning institution in the world.
